 - Define and maintain role taxonomies, access request workflows, and entitlement review processes that satisfy CMMC, FedRAMP, and NIST 800-171 access control requirements.

 - Conduct periodic access reviews and certification campaigns, working with system owners to validate that entitlements remain appropriate and revoke unnecessary access.

 - Develop and maintain access control documentation, including role definitions, provisioning procedures, and audit evidence required for compliance assessments.

 - Enforce segregation of duties controls across critical systems, identifying and remediating access conflicts that create compliance or operational risk.

MDM Management & Provisioning

· Architect, deploy, and manage a unified Mobile Device Management (MDM) solution across macOS, Windows, Linux, and iOS/Android endpoints, ensuring consistent security baselines and configuration compliance across all device types.

· Establish and maintain OS-level hardening benchmarks (CIS, DISA STIG) across macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints, translating requirements into enforced MDM policies and automated remediation workflows

· Define and enforce MDM configuration profiles, compliance policies, and conditional access rules across all managed platforms in alignment with CMMC, NIST 800-53, and organizational security standards

SSO & Application Integration

 - Lead SSO onboarding for new SaaS applications, internal tools, and government-facing platforms, ensuring integrations conform to Northwood's authentication standards and security policies.

 - Evaluate and enforce SAML, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0 implementation standards across integrated applications, identifying and remediating misconfigurations that introduce identity risk.

 - Partner with the Security Engineering Lead to ensure Okta log ingestion, anomaly detection, and identity-based alerting are functioning and continuously tuned within the SIEM environment.

 - Support integration of identity controls with endpoint management platforms, ensuring device trust policies are enforced as part of access decisions.

Privileged Access & Secrets Management

 - Design and maintain privileged access management controls for administrative accounts, service accounts, and break-glass access procedures across corporate and government environments.

 - Define and enforce service account governance standards, including credential rotation policies, least-privilege scoping, and audit logging requirements.

 - Collaborate with the Product Security Lead on secrets management integration with identity controls, ensuring service-to-service authentication conforms to zero-trust principles.

Compliance & Cross-Functional Collaboration

 - Ensure Northwood's IAM environment satisfies access control requirements across CMMC Level 2, FedRAMP, SOC 2, and ITAR, providing audit evidence and control documentation to the GRC Lead as needed.

 - Partner with the GRC Lead to support access control–related audit activities, including evidence collection, assessor walkthroughs, and remediation of identified deficiencies.

 - Collaborate with the network engineering team to ensure identity-aware network access controls and Zero Trust policies are consistently enforced across Cloudflare and on-premises environments.

 - Develop and maintain IAM architecture documentation, including data flow diagrams, integration maps, and access control matrices that reflect Northwood's current environment.



Basic Qualifications

 - 3+ years of hands-on IAM engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of Okta administration in a production environment.

 - Deep Okta expertise, including SSO configuration, lifecycle management, MFA policy enforcement, adaptive authentication, Okta Workflows, and SIEM log integration.

 - Strong understanding of SSO protocols including SAML 2.0, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0, with hands-on experience troubleshooting and hardening integrations.

 - Experience designing and implementing RBAC frameworks, including role taxonomy development, entitlement reviews, and access certification processes.

 - Familiarity with privileged access management concepts, including service account governance, least-privilege enforcement, and administrative access controls.

 - Understanding of IAM requirements within government compliance frameworks, including NIST 800-171 access control and identification and authentication control families.

 - Experience integrating identity platforms with endpoint management, cloud environments, and security monitoring tooling.

 - Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI clearance.

 - U.S. citizenship or status as a lawful permanent resident required to conform with ITAR export regulations.



Preferred Qualifications

 - Active TS clearance or higher.

 - Experience operating Okta in AWS GovCloud or Microsoft GCC environments, including tenant configuration for government workload access controls.

 - Familiarity with Okta Identity Governance (OIG) or similar identity governance and administration (IGA) platforms.

 - Experience with Cloudflare Zero Trust access policies and integration with Okta for identity-aware network access enforcement.

 - Hands-on experience with privileged access management platforms such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, or equivalent.

 - Background in aerospace, defense, critical infrastructure, or other government-adjacent regulated environments.

 - Experience supporting CMMC, FedRAMP, or SOC 2 audits in an IAM engineering capacity.

 - Okta Certified Administrator, Okta Certified Professional, or equivalent identity platform certification.

 - CISSP, CISM, or equivalent professional security certification.

jobs.title: Senior Accounting Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role:

We are seeking a Senior Accounting Manager to support in building and scaling Northwood’s accounting operations and financial infrastructure. This role will lead month end and cost accounting processes, ensure accurate and timely financial reporting, and drive operational excellence across day-to-day accounting functions.

Beyond supervising the day-to-day transaction cycles, the Senior Accounting Manager will play a vital role in executing the operational strategy required to transition accounting workflows in-house, implement robust financial software tools, and create a corporate culture centered on compliance, precise capital tracking, and resource accountability.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Execute and oversee the day-to-day general ledger activities, ensuring accurate, timely record-keeping in accordance with US GAAP.

  • Support the Controller in designing, implementing, and maintaining company-wide financial controls and accounting policies that foster financial discipline.

  • Manage the configuration, maintenance, and data integrity of the corporate accounting system, identifying bottlenecks and optimizing system workflows.

  • Coordinate schedules and prepare underlying workpapers for external audits and tax compliance.

  • Collaborate with local bookkeepers in international jurisdictions to ensure timely month-end close and accurate reporting

  • Lead cost accounting efforts and collaborate with production, supply chain and engineering to lead unit cost reduction efforts

  • Partner with finance to support cost reduction efforts, fundraising, forecasting and executive reporting

  • Implement process improvements to decrease month end close timelines, scale systems efficiently and automate accounting workflows

Accounts Payable and Procurement Operations

  • End-to-end AP process, including invoice validation, PO matching, and proper coding.

  • Review and authorize payment runs (ACH, wires, checks) for final Controller approval.

  • Oversee the resolution of complex vendor invoice discrepancies and inquiries.

  • Administer corporate credit card and employee expense reimbursement platforms, enforcing strict adherence to corporate travel and entertainment policies.

  • Produce AP aging analyses and spend reports to assist with cash commitment insights.

Accounts Receivable and Revenue Management

  • Oversee customer invoice generation and transmission in alignment with contracts and milestones.

  • Manage collection activities, follow up on overdue accounts, and escalate billing disputes.

  • Prepare AR aging reports and collections metrics to help mitigate credit risks.

  • Analyze monthly variances between projected and actual receipts to refine cash flow models.

  • Partner with business development and legal teams to evaluate contract terms, billing structures, and revenue recognition under ASC 606 prior to execution, ensuring financial integrity and compliance from contract inception

  • Own monthly cash management cycle, including maintenance of cash file, cash positioning, forecasting updates, and reporting to senior leadership

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related Business discipline.

  • 5+ years of progressive, professional corporate accounting experience

  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP, multi-entity financial reporting, ASC 606 , and internal controls framework across domestic and international operations.

  • Demonstrated experience operating within a fast-paced, inventory-driven hardware, manufacturing environment.

  • Proficiency with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) financial software, specifically NetSuite or a comparable system.

  • A deeply hands-on approach and attention to detail, showing equal enthusiasm for completing foundational operational tasks and managing structured accounting projects.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or Certified Management Accountant (CMA) designation.

  • Prior accounting experience within the aerospace, satellite, telecommunications, or defense industrial sectors.

  • Familiarity with SQL or advanced data analysis tools to construct custom reporting pipelines for procurement, inventory, or billing structures.

  • Proven success building, scaling, and mentoring a lean accounting team during phases of high organizational growth

Additional Information:

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role:

Northwood is seeking a talented Mechanical Engineer to join our dynamic team, specializing in the design of structures, systems, tooling, and other products for our ground station antennas. This role will involve designing and developing hardware that will be deployed all over the world as well as fabrication and assembly tooling, test fixtures, and more. You will work closely with RF engineers, electrical engineers, manufacturing engineers, and software engineers.

Responsibilities:

  • Design multiple product lines, structures, mechanisms, environmental systems, and GSE for satellite ground stations ensuring performance, reliability, and manufacturability.

  • Design manufacturable, intricate RF waveguide filtering and feed structures for high performance antennas

  • Design tooling for fabrication and assembly processes, including test fixtures and weldments.

  • Collaborate with RF, electrical, and manufacturing to ensure reasonable system requirements and seamless integration of designs and hardware.

  • Ensure compliance with industry standards, regulations, and best practices in mechanical, thermal, and environmental design.

  • Participate in design reviews and provide feedback to ensure design objectives are met.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience designing and building hardware.

  • Experience with taking a product from concept to production.

  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes and ability to design for manufacturability.

  • Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, including thermal management, materials selection, and structural analysis.

Preferred Skills:

  • Proficiency in Siemens NX for 3D modeling, assembly, and drafting

  • Understanding of environmental and reliability testing procedures for mechanical systems.

  • Experience with weldments, tooling, GSE, and fixture design and assembly.

  • Experience with mechanical/thermal simulation tools (e.g. ANSYS)

  • Basic understanding of electrical systems and components to ensure a holistic approach to system design

  • Basic understanding of RF systems and devices.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed

  • This role requires being on-site 5 days per week

jobs.title: Build and Release Engineer (DevOps)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role

Northwood's engineers ship software to the cloud and to ground stations in the field. We're looking for a Developer Experience Engineer to own the build system, CI pipelines, test harness integrations, and developer environments that FPGA, embedded, DSP, cloud, and ground teams use every day. You will build the paved paths those teams adopt for their own targets, measure how fast and reliably they get from commit to release, and strive to make that number better. This role sits within the Platform team and works with every engineering discipline at Northwood.

Responsibilities

  • Own the build system: reproducibility, caching, build times, and cross-platform targets spanning cloud services, embedded firmware, and FPGA gateware.

  • Design and maintain reusable GitLab CI templates and pipeline components, with fast early checks ahead of expensive builds and tests, and drive down flakiness and cycle time with data.

  • Build reproducible developer environments so new engineers are productive on day one.

  • Implement release automation and promotion mechanics from development through staging to production, including artifact signing and supply chain checks.

  • Instrument the build and CI system, publish developer productivity metrics, and use them to prioritize the tooling roadmap.

  • Support engineers on build and pipeline issues and turn recurring problems into permanent fixes.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of experience in build engineering, DevOps, CI/CD, developer productivity, or platform engineering.

  • Hands-on experience owning CI pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Buildkite, or similar) for a multi-team codebase.

  • Proficiency in Python and shell scripting; ability to read and build Rust or C/C++ projects.

  • Solid understanding of containers, Linux, and Git workflows.

  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose and fix slow or unreliable builds, with specific examples.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Production experience with Nix, OCI, and hermetic build systems.

  • Experience with cross-compilation and embedded or FPGA toolchains.

  • Experience with remote build caching and distributed builds.

  • Familiarity with software supply chain security tooling, SAST, DAST, and SBOMs.

  • Exposure to Kubernetes, ArgoCD, or GitOps deployment patterns.

  • Experience in a regulated environment (CMMC, NIST 800-171, or similar) where build provenance matters.

jobs.title: Hardware Development Engineer (DSP)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role:

As a Hardware Development Engineer, you will lead the development of Northwood’s antenna systems from early architecture through design, integration, manufacturing, and deployment. You will own the execution of multidisciplinary antenna products that combine mechanical structures, RF hardware, electronics, embedded systems, thermal management, manufacturing, and test.

This role is for a deeply technical engineer who can operate as both a senior individual contributor and a cross-functional product lead. You will apply strong expertise in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, RF hardware, embedded systems, or a related discipline while developing the system-level understanding needed to drive the complete antenna product.

You will translate product and mission objectives into clear requirements, technical plans, schedules, interfaces, and verification strategies. You will organize teams around the most important engineering problems, identify risks and dependencies early, and drive products through design reviews, prototype builds, testing, production, and field deployment.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical development and execution of a Northwood antenna system or major subsystem from concept through production and deployment.

  • Translate product, customer, and mission needs into system requirements, architectures, interfaces, performance budgets, and verification plans.

  • Coordinate development across mechanical, electrical, RF, antenna, embedded software, thermal, manufacturing, test, supply chain, and field operations.

  • Build and manage development schedules, technical milestones, critical-path dependencies, and risk-mitigation plans.

  • Lead system-level trade studies across antenna performance, structural design, power, thermal behavior, reliability, manufacturability, cost, and deployment speed.

  • Drive prototype builds, system integration, test campaigns, root-cause investigations, and production-readiness reviews.

  • Contribute directly to design, analysis, prototyping, testing, and troubleshooting within your primary engineering discipline.

  • Provide clear updates to engineering leadership on progress, risks, decisions, and resource needs.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, RF Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • 3-5+ years of experience developing complex hardware, antenna systems, RF products, aerospace systems, or similarly multidisciplinary technology.

  • Deep individual-contributor expertise in at least one relevant engineering discipline, such as mechanical design, electrical hardware, RF hardware, antenna engineering, embedded systems, or systems integration.

  • Demonstrated experience owning a complex hardware product or subsystem through design, prototyping, integration, testing, and delivery.

  • Strong systems-thinking ability and experience managing technical interfaces and tradeoffs across multiple engineering disciplines.

  • Experience turning ambiguous product objectives into requirements, development plans, schedules, and test strategies.

  • Hands-on experience building, integrating, testing, and troubleshooting physical hardware systems.

  • Strong organization, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing phased-array antennas, ground station antennas, satellite communications systems, radar systems, or other complex RF hardware.

jobs.title: Identity & Endpoint Security Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role:

As an Identity & Endpoint Security Engineer, you will own the design and implementation of Northwood's identity architecture, ensuring that access to corporate systems, cloud environments, and sensitive government workloads is governed by robust, auditable, and least-privilege controls. This is a mid-level individual contributor role for an engineer with deep Okta expertise and a strong foundation in IAM architecture, SSO, and role-based access control across complex hybrid environments.

You will serve as Northwood's IAM subject-matter expert, designing and maintaining the identity fabric that connects corporate users, contractors, and service accounts to the tools and systems they need — while enforcing the access boundaries required for CUI handling, ITAR compliance, and CMMC Level 2 certification. This role works in close partnership with the Security Engineering Lead, Security Operations Lead, and GRC Lead, and reports to the Head of Security.

Responsibilities

Identity Architecture & Okta Administration

  • Own Northwood's Okta environment end-to-end, including tenant configuration, application integrations, lifecycle management, MFA policy enforcement, and directory synchronization.

  • Design and maintain Northwood's SSO architecture, ensuring all corporate and government-facing applications are integrated into a consistent, auditable authentication framework.

  • Develop and enforce adaptive authentication policies, step-up MFA configurations, and risk-based access controls aligned to the sensitivity of the systems being accessed.

  • Manage Okta workflows and automation to support user provisioning, deprovisioning, and access change processes across the employee and contractor lifecycle.

  • Maintain Okta system health, audit logging, and integration reliability, ensuring identity telemetry flows into Northwood's SIEM for continuous monitoring.

RBAC & Access Governance

  • Design and implement role-based access control frameworks across Northwood's corporate systems, cloud environments, and government workloads, ensuring access is granted on a least-privilege and need-to-know basis.

  • Define and maintain role taxonomies, access request workflows, and entitlement review processes that satisfy CMMC, FedRAMP, and NIST 800-171 access control requirements.

  • Conduct periodic access reviews and certification campaigns, working with system owners to validate that entitlements remain appropriate and revoke unnecessary access.

  • Develop and maintain access control documentation, including role definitions, provisioning procedures, and audit evidence required for compliance assessments.

  • Enforce segregation of duties controls across critical systems, identifying and remediating access conflicts that create compliance or operational risk.

MDM Management & Provisioning

· Architect, deploy, and manage a unified Mobile Device Management (MDM) solution across macOS, Windows, Linux, and iOS/Android endpoints, ensuring consistent security baselines and configuration compliance across all device types.

· Establish and maintain OS-level hardening benchmarks (CIS, DISA STIG) across macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints, translating requirements into enforced MDM policies and automated remediation workflows

· Define and enforce MDM configuration profiles, compliance policies, and conditional access rules across all managed platforms in alignment with CMMC, NIST 800-53, and organizational security standards

SSO & Application Integration

  • Lead SSO onboarding for new SaaS applications, internal tools, and government-facing platforms, ensuring integrations conform to Northwood's authentication standards and security policies.

  • Evaluate and enforce SAML, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0 implementation standards across integrated applications, identifying and remediating misconfigurations that introduce identity risk.

  • Partner with the Security Engineering Lead to ensure Okta log ingestion, anomaly detection, and identity-based alerting are functioning and continuously tuned within the SIEM environment.

  • Support integration of identity controls with endpoint management platforms, ensuring device trust policies are enforced as part of access decisions.

Privileged Access & Secrets Management

  • Design and maintain privileged access management controls for administrative accounts, service accounts, and break-glass access procedures across corporate and government environments.

  • Define and enforce service account governance standards, including credential rotation policies, least-privilege scoping, and audit logging requirements.

  • Collaborate with the Product Security Lead on secrets management integration with identity controls, ensuring service-to-service authentication conforms to zero-trust principles.

Compliance & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Ensure Northwood's IAM environment satisfies access control requirements across CMMC Level 2, FedRAMP, SOC 2, and ITAR, providing audit evidence and control documentation to the GRC Lead as needed.

  • Partner with the GRC Lead to support access control–related audit activities, including evidence collection, assessor walkthroughs, and remediation of identified deficiencies.

  • Collaborate with the network engineering team to ensure identity-aware network access controls and Zero Trust policies are consistently enforced across Cloudflare and on-premises environments.

  • Develop and maintain IAM architecture documentation, including data flow diagrams, integration maps, and access control matrices that reflect Northwood's current environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on IAM engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of Okta administration in a production environment.

  • Deep Okta expertise, including SSO configuration, lifecycle management, MFA policy enforcement, adaptive authentication, Okta Workflows, and SIEM log integration.

  • Strong understanding of SSO protocols including SAML 2.0, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0, with hands-on experience troubleshooting and hardening integrations.

  • Experience designing and implementing RBAC frameworks, including role taxonomy development, entitlement reviews, and access certification processes.

  • Familiarity with privileged access management concepts, including service account governance, least-privilege enforcement, and administrative access controls.

  • Understanding of IAM requirements within government compliance frameworks, including NIST 800-171 access control and identification and authentication control families.

  • Experience integrating identity platforms with endpoint management, cloud environments, and security monitoring tooling.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI clearance.

  • U.S. citizenship or status as a lawful permanent resident required to conform with ITAR export regulations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active TS clearance or higher.

  • Experience operating Okta in AWS GovCloud or Microsoft GCC environments, including tenant configuration for government workload access controls.

  • Familiarity with Okta Identity Governance (OIG) or similar identity governance and administration (IGA) platforms.

  • Experience with Cloudflare Zero Trust access policies and integration with Okta for identity-aware network access enforcement.

  • Hands-on experience with privileged access management platforms such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, or equivalent.

  • Background in aerospace, defense, critical infrastructure, or other government-adjacent regulated environments.

  • Experience supporting CMMC, FedRAMP, or SOC 2 audits in an IAM engineering capacity.

  • Okta Certified Administrator, Okta Certified Professional, or equivalent identity platform certification.

  • CISSP, CISM, or equivalent professional security certification.

Additional Information:

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Northwood Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Northwood Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process, please reach out to accommodations@northwoodspace.io

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role:

Northwood is building a global network of next-generation ground stations, and we’re looking for an RF Systems Architect to define the products that power that network. You will translate customer needs and network-level analysis into concrete product definitions – what we build, how it performs, and how it scales. You will work closely with Sites, Business Development, and Engineering leadership to aggregate demand across customers, shape product direction, and drive alignment on what Northwood brings to market. This role is highly cross-functional and high-leverage, sitting at the intersection of customer requirements, system design, and product execution / evolution.

Responsibilities:

  • Translate network-level inputs (capacity, coverage, latency, deployment timing) into concrete product architectures.

  • Define RF and system-level parameters, including antenna configurations, link performance targets, throughput, and availability requirements.

  • Develop and iterate on solution architectures using simulation outputs, link budgets, and real-world constraints to ensure technical and operational viability.

  • Partner with Business Development to shape customer engagements and support proposals.

  • Drive alignment with Engineering Leadership on system tradeoffs, product direction and roadmap, and deliver clear, execution-ready system definitions.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, physics, or mathematics.

  • 5-10+ years of experience in systems engineering, solutions architecture, or technical product roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex, cross-functional systems.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Working knowledge of RF systems, ground stations, satellite communications, or related infrastructure.

  • Proven ability to operate across disciplines (hardware, software, network, operations) and drive alignment across teams.

  • Excellent communications skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and competing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience defining and deploying complex communications, networking, aerospace, or infrastructure systems at scale

  • Strong understanding of RF systems, satellite communications, network architecture tradeoffs, and system performance analysis

  • Ability to translate customer requirements and operational constraints into scalable technical product definitions and execution-ready architectures

  • Experience partnering with customers, business development, and engineering teams to shape proposals, product direction, and roadmap decisions

  • Strong systems thinking, technical judgment, and ability to drive alignment across cross-functional teams in fast-paced environments

Solutions Architect/Level 4: $153,000 - $207,000 per year

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer- Fleet Operations & Reliability
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role:
Northwood is building a global network of next-generation ground stations, and we're looking for a Fleet Operations & Reliability Engineer who is equal parts technical expert, field operator, and builder. You will be the first line of defense for all operations on our network - the extreme owner of uptime and performance for our deployed hardware worldwide. Your work will span most technical disciplines at the company giving you broad technical exposure across the stack, and will require you to build consensus across multiple teams.

Day-to-day, you'll move between operating our hardware - interpreting live telemetry, driving incident response, analyzing performance data - and leading field campaigns to deploy, diagnose, and upgrade hardware at remote sites. As you build deep knowledge of our systems, you'll be positioned to drive scalable, automated monitoring and response systems.

This position is based at our Los Angeles headquarters with frequent opportunities to travel to sites.

Responsibilities:

  • Own fleet uptime and performance. Deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot a growing network of antennas distributed across the globe. Write your own analyses to dig into performance trends and uptime data.

  • Operate and grow our Network Operations Center. Monitor site health, interpret telemetry, send commands and configurations, and drive rapid detection and response for any site or hardware issue. Build the systems that enable response at scale.

  • Support the rapid expansion of the network by leading hardware deployment campaigns at remote sites around the world. Act as the on-site conductor and POC for hardware deployments and site checkouts. Owning the process from pre-deploy through first contact. Lead from the front in the field.

  • Investigate and troubleshoot, then close the loop. Drive root cause analysis on failures and implement fixes that reduce future recurrence. Develop deep expertise in at least one major subsystem — RF, power, networking, or mechanical.

  • Scale our global contractor ecosystem. Source, contract, and onboard regional partners across domestic and international sites — including maintenance agreements, SLAs, onboarding guides, and ongoing task coordination. Define maintenance and sparing strategies.

  • Partner closely with product, manufacturing, and test teams to influence designs with a focus on system reliability, maintainability, and long-term lifecycle performance.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, or related engineering discipline

  • Experience building, testing, operating, or diagnosing complex electrical or mechanical systems

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to work across multiple engineering disciplines and diverse teams

  • Experience operating hardware systems in a live environment — interpreting telemetry, sending commands, and troubleshooting in real time

  • Prior experience managing field operations, contractors, or vendor relationships across multiple sites

  • Extreme organization, with strong project management and communication skills

  • Hands-on field experience with proficiency using hand and power tools, test equipment, and standard field diagnostics

  • Comfort writing and running code (e.g., Python, SQL, or other scripting languages)

  • Proficiency in 2D or 3D CAD for modeling and/or drawing creation

jobs.title: DSP Engineer (Platform)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role:

We are looking for a DSP Engineer to own the definition and development of modem algorithms for our next-generation radio platform. You will work within our existing in-house SDR and FPGA infrastructure, taking substantial ownership over the modem end-to-end — from waveform definition through implementation and validation.


You will work closely with RF, FPGA, and systems engineers to integrate modem algorithms into a high-performance communications platform for our satellite ground network.
This role is a great fit for an engineer who thinks fluently in waveforms and signal chains and is comfortable moving that thinking into real implementation, without needing to own the surrounding RF hardware, data-converter, clocking, or embedded systems architecture.


Responsibilities:

  • Own the definition and development of modem algorithms end-to-end, from requirements through implementation and validation

  • Define waveform processing chains — synchronization, pulse shaping, equalization, and related signal-processing functions — for implementation on an in-house SDR platform or FPGA

  • Partition and implement modem signal-processing functions across FPGA logic and embedded/host-based compute, working within the existing hardware platform

  • Collaborate with RF, FPGA, and systems engineers to integrate modem algorithms into the end-to-end system and validate performance

  • Develop and run communication system tests to characterize modem performance under realistic channel impairments

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree with 0-4 years of relevant experience in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field

  • Experience developing modems or waveform processing chains for SDR, wireless communications, radar, or similar RF systems

  • Strong understanding of digital communications theory: CCSDS waveforms, BPSK/QPSK/OQPSK, DVB-S2, carrier synchronization, pulse shaping, equalization, and Doppler effects

  • Demonstrated ability to carry waveform algorithms from analysis and prototyping through to a working implementation, rather than stopping at simulation

  • Working understanding of the complete signal chain and how modem design decisions interact with RF and hardware constraints

  • Experience with communication system testing and performance characterization

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with bit-equivalence verification through FPGAs

  • Familiarity with SDR frameworks such as GNU Radio

  • Experience with real-time signal processing

  • Systems programming skills in C++ or Rust, with Rust especially valued

  • Experience with beamforming, radar, or electronic warfare (EW) systems

Additional Information:

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role:

As a Hardware Development Engineer, you will lead the development of Northwood’s antenna systems from early architecture through design, integration, manufacturing, and deployment. You will own the execution of multidisciplinary antenna products that combine mechanical structures, RF hardware, electronics, embedded systems, thermal management, manufacturing, and test.

This role is for a deeply technical engineer who can operate as both a senior individual contributor and a cross-functional product lead. You will apply strong expertise in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, RF hardware, embedded systems, or a related discipline while developing the system-level understanding needed to drive the complete antenna product.

You will translate product and mission objectives into clear requirements, technical plans, schedules, interfaces, and verification strategies. You will organize teams around the most important engineering problems, identify risks and dependencies early, and drive products through design reviews, prototype builds, testing, production, and field deployment.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical development and execution of a Northwood antenna system or major subsystem from concept through production and deployment.

  • Translate product, customer, and mission needs into system requirements, architectures, interfaces, performance budgets, and verification plans.

  • Coordinate development across mechanical, electrical, RF, antenna, embedded software, thermal, manufacturing, test, supply chain, and field operations.

  • Build and manage development schedules, technical milestones, critical-path dependencies, and risk-mitigation plans.

  • Lead system-level trade studies across antenna performance, structural design, power, thermal behavior, reliability, manufacturability, cost, and deployment speed.

  • Drive prototype builds, system integration, test campaigns, root-cause investigations, and production-readiness reviews.

  • Contribute directly to design, analysis, prototyping, testing, and troubleshooting within your primary engineering discipline.

  • Provide clear updates to engineering leadership on progress, risks, decisions, and resource needs.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, RF Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • 5+ years of experience developing complex hardware, antenna systems, RF products, aerospace systems, or similarly multidisciplinary technology.

  • Deep individual-contributor expertise in at least one relevant engineering discipline, such as mechanical design, electrical hardware, RF hardware, antenna engineering, embedded systems, or systems integration.

  • Demonstrated experience owning a complex hardware product or subsystem through design, prototyping, integration, testing, and delivery.

  • Strong systems-thinking ability and experience managing technical interfaces and tradeoffs across multiple engineering disciplines.

  • Experience turning ambiguous product objectives into requirements, development plans, schedules, and test strategies.

  • Hands-on experience building, integrating, testing, and troubleshooting physical hardware systems.

  • Strong organization, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing phased-array antennas, ground station antennas, satellite communications systems, radar systems, or other complex RF hardware.

  • Experience with antenna structures, RF enclosures, electronics packaging, thermal management, environmental sealing, cable routing, or electromechanical integration.

  • Familiarity with antenna elements, amplifiers, filters, frequency converters, beamforming electronics, calibration systems, and RF distribution networks.

  • Experience taking a hardware product from early architecture through qualification, production, installation, and field operation.

  • Experience with environmental testing, design for manufacturing, supplier management, and production-readiness processes.

  • Track record of resolving complex integration issues across mechanical, electrical, RF, embedded, and software boundaries.

jobs.title: Senior RF Electrical Engineer (Prism)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role:

As a Senior RF Electrical Engineer, you will design and own RF hardware for Prism, Northwood's 2.4-meter parabolic antenna for high-throughput satellite links. You will work across Prism's multi-band RF chain (receive front ends, frequency conversion, filtering, and the transmit line-up that drives Prism's high power amplifiers), taking hardware from architecture through prototype, characterization, and production. You will make system-level RF performance trades and collaborate across hardware, software, and test teams to deliver hardware that performs in the field.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Design RF electronics hardware for Prism, and iterate on existing Prism hardware to improve reliability, performance, and manufacturability

  • Own RF line-up design for Prism's receive and transmit chains, balancing gain, noise figure, linearity, output power, and blocker/interference tolerance

  • Design and trade RF architectures that support Prism's multiple frequency bands, including band switching, filtering, and shared signal paths

  • Create electromagnetic simulation models of Prism hardware (amplifiers, filters, PCB layout) to design and evaluate performance

  • Build RF circuits for Prism (LNAs, filters, power amplifiers, frequency converters) as well as support circuitry (power, digital control), and characterize their performance

 

Basic Qualifications:

If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role:

The Incoming Quality Technician manages daily operations of the Incoming Inspection Room, including inspection tools, fixtures, calibration, and ESD controls. The technician verifies incoming PCBs, PCBAs, machined and welded mechanical parts, and other supplier materials against drawings and approved inspection requirements. The role works with Supplier Quality (SQE) and Engineering to resolve inspection issues and prevent nonconforming material from entering production. The technician also supports engineering samples, product verification, and drawing and DFM improvements through accurate measurement data.

Responsibilities:

  • Inspect incoming PCB/PCBA and mechanical parts against drawings, specifications, approved inspection plans, and applicable IPC-A-600 and IPC-A-610 criteria, using critical-characteristic checks, 100% inspection, or AQL sampling as specified.

  • Apply Northwood Space’s T1 (Production) and T2 (Engineering/R&D) part pedigree requirements; verify supplier CoCs, inspection reports, traceability records, and applicable FAI/PPAP documentation and approval status.

  • Manage the Incoming Inspection Room, including measurement tools, equipment, custom fixtures, calibration schedules, records, and calibration providers; maintain ESD controls and handling practices in accordance with ANSI/ESD S20.20.

  • Record inspection results and material traceability in the manufacturing system; identify and transfer nonconforming material to the MRB cage and coordinate disposition with the Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) and Responsible Engineer (RE).

  • Provide dimensional measurement, inspection, and product verification support for engineering samples, prototypes, and first articles; conduct Gage Repeatability and Reproducibility (Gage R&R) studies to verify measurement system capability.

  • Share inspection data and feedback with Engineering and suppliers to support drawing corrections, design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements, and supplier quality investigations.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of hands-on incoming or quality inspection experience with PCB/PCBA and/or mechanical parts, including working knowledge of IPC-A-600 / IPC-A-610 acceptance criteria and ESD controls and handling practices.

  • Proficiency in interpreting PCB/PCBA and complex mechanical engineering drawings, including GD&T, datum references, dimensional tolerances, and critical characteristics; ability to follow risk-based inspection plans, including 100% inspection and AQL sampling.

  • Hands-on proficiency with precision measurement and inspection equipment, including handheld tools, VMMs, optical inspection systems, and custom fixtures, plus experience managing calibration schedules, status tracking, and records.

  • Experience identifying and documenting nonconforming materials, communicating quality issues to Supplier Quality (SQE) and Engineering, and using Manufacturo or similar ERP/MES systems to record inspection results, maintain material traceability, and manage NCR/MRB processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in aerospace, high-reliability electronics, or electromechanical manufacturing; familiarity with AS9100.

  • Experience managing calibration programs, using ISO/IEC 17025-accredited calibration providers, and supporting Gage R&R or other measurement system studies.

  • Familiarity with APQP, PPAP, AS9102 FAI, and different quality and inspection requirements based on part pedigree as (Production) and (Engineering/R&D).

  • Experience with PCB/ PCBA inspection (e.g., bow/twist, holes, plating, surface finish) and mechanical machining or weld inspection.

  • IPC-A-600 or IPC-A-610 certification.

  • Experience with CMM

Additional Information:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

  • Design hardware, wiring, and electrical systems to support electrical and RF testing for both production and development needs (fixtures, harnesses, interfaces, rack integration)

  • Develop modular and reusable test automation software, including frameworks, drivers, and tooling in Linux environments using Python / Rust / C++

  • Experience writing reusable test software patterns (hardware abstraction layers, driver libraries, test sequencing frameworks)

Role:

We are seeking a Supply Chain Operations Intern to join our team for the summer in 2027. You will play a critical role in ensuring our satellite ground station manufacturing and deployment run smoothly and efficiently. This is a highly technical, hands-on role where you’ll work with complex supply chain systems, track precision components, and optimize processes to support cutting-edge technology.

You will dive into data-driven operations, analyzing inventory, supplier performance, and logistics metrics to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement. You’ll help implement automated tracking, develop dashboards, and support planning initiatives that directly influence production schedules and deployment timelines. This role provides a rare opportunity to see how operational strategy, technical requirements, and high-stakes manufacturing intersect in the fast-paced space technology sector.

  • Help implement process improvements to increase efficiency, reduce waste, and mitigate operational risks.

  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and operational teams.

jobs.title: Capture Strategist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role:

Northwood Space is seeking a Capture Strategist to shape and win strategic opportunities across U.S. Government, international government, and commercial customers. This person owns opportunities from early identification through award: building customer relationships, reading procurement and competitive signals, shaping win strategy, and running proposal execution to get deals across the line.

This role sits at the intersection of business development and strategy. The right candidate builds trust with customers early, understands competitive dynamics, and knows how to turn a well-shaped opportunity into a winning proposal. They will work closely with growth, engineering, mission, product, and leadership teams across the full opportunity lifecycle.

Responsibilities:

  • Own capture strategy for priority opportunities across U.S. Government, international government, and commercial customers, from opportunity identification through award

  • Build and manage customer relationships ahead of formal solicitations to understand mission needs, procurement timelines, and decision criteria

  • Assess competitive landscape and develop win themes, teaming strategy, and differentiated positioning

  • Lead black hat assessments, price-to-win analysis, and go/no-go recommendations

  • Serve as primary author and project manager for proposals, coordinating inputs across business development, engineering, product, mission management, legal, and finance

  • Build and maintain capture playbooks, competitive intelligence, and reusable proposal infrastructure

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in capture, business development, or proposal strategy roles in aerospace, defense, government technology, or other complex technical industries

  • Experience shaping opportunities pre-RFP, including customer engagement, competitive positioning, and teaming strategy

  • Experience leading or supporting responses to RFIs, RFPs, or similar solicitations

  • Ability to work in-person in Los Angeles or Washington, DC

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the space industry, including familiarity with SATCOM, RF, and communications infrastructure

  • Experience capturing U.S. Government opportunities, including defense, civil, or national security agencies

  • Experience with commercial or international customer capture, strategic bids, or partnership development

  • Familiarity with federal acquisition processes and evaluation criteria

  • Comfort using AI tools to speed proposal development and content reuse

  • Experience at an early-stage startup or other fast-paced, high-growth environment

This person will lead Northwood's engagement across priority commercial accounts spanning satellite communications, direct-to-device and IoT connectivity, Earth observation, and the emerging in-space economy, and will serve as a strategic partner to leadership, product, engineering, and mission teams as we expand our footprint in these markets.

  • Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across commercial space operators and adjacent industry, including executives, technical leaders, procurement, and partner organizations

  • Create and execute account and campaign strategies for priority commercial customers, market segments, and adjacent partners

  • Identify, shape, and pursue opportunities aligned to Northwood's capabilities in areas such as commercial space communications, ground infrastructure, sensing, and other critical commercial space priorities

  • Partner closely with product, engineering, mission management, and leadership teams to translate customer needs into company strategy, technical positioning, capture, and successful program execution

  • Provide insight into commercial space market dynamics, funding trends, and customer requirements to inform Northwood's product direction and long-term growth plans

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in business development, growth, capture, program strategy, or related roles supporting or serving commercial space or adjacent technology customers

  • Experience developing, shaping, or executing complex technical programs or opportunities relevant to commercial space customers, with knowledge of commercial space markets, business models, and buying dynamics

  • Ability to work in-person in Los Angeles or Washington, DC

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with or within SATCOM, direct-to-device/IoT, Earth observation, or in-space economy companies (orbital transfer vehicles, in-space assembly and manufacturing, re-entry)

  • Experience engaging with commercial space operators, investors, or industry partners on business-critical needs

jobs.title: Senior Creative Producer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role:

The Marcom Design Team owns, develops, and stewards Northwood's marketing and communications across brand identity, go-to-market campaigns, digital, .com, and product initiatives.

The team is looking for a Senior Creative Producer to lead the production of that work from brief to final delivery. This role owns scope, schedule, budget, and resourcing across campaigns, video and motion, photography, digital, .com, social, print, merchandise, and events, and is the connective tissue between creative, marketing, communications, product, and external partners. The producer protects the creative vision through every stage of production and ensures work ships on time, on budget, and at the highest level of craft.

The ideal candidate is calm under pressure, obsessive about the details, and able to turn complexity and ambiguity into a clear plan that everyone can follow.

Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end production of creative work from brief through concept, production, post-production, and final delivery

  • Define project scope with internal and external partners, and build and manage schedules, budgets, and resource plans that hold up under change

  • Lead production of video, motion, photography, and static content, including shoots, edits, and asset finishing

  • Source, brief, negotiate with, and manage external partners such as production companies, photographers, animators, editors, print vendors, and freelancers

  • Run the operating rhythm of the team: kickoffs, reviews, approvals, status, and handoffs, keeping information and deliverables moving across all stakeholders

  • Manage asset delivery, specs, versioning, and localization so final files are correct for every channel and partner

  • Oversee print and merchandise production, including quotes, proofs, press checks, and quality control

  • Partner with the Head of Creative to prioritize the team's workload, forecast capacity, and flag risk early

  • Establish and document production processes, templates, and tooling that make the team faster and more consistent

  • Manage confidentiality around unannounced products and launches

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience producing creative or marketing work, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead producer role at a brand, agency, or production company

  • A track record of shipping integrated campaigns across video, digital, .com, social, and print at a high level of craft

  • Proven ability to independently manage budgets, timelines, scope, and production and post-production partners

  • Deep familiarity with video, photo, and motion production, from pre-production through delivery

  • Working knowledge of print and manufacturing practices, including color, stock, finishing, and vendor management

  • Fluency in production and project management tools, and comfort working alongside designers in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite

  • Strong negotiation and vendor management skills, with an established network of production partners

  • Clear, direct communication and the ability to align designers, marketers, engineers, and executives around one plan

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience producing live events, trade shows, or product launches

  • Experience in a technology, hardware, or aerospace company

  • Familiarity with 3D, real-time, or AI-assisted production workflows

Additional Information:

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior RF Electrical Engineer, Amplifiers (Prism)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role:

As a Senior Electrical Engineer (RF), you will own Ka-band high power amplifier design for Prism, Northwood's 2.4-meter parabolic antenna for high-throughput satellite links. You will take amplifiers from architecture through prototype, characterization, and production, working closely with antenna, mechanical, thermal, and test engineers. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who has designed, built, and debugged high power RF hardware at microwave or millimeter-wave frequencies.

Responsibilities:

  • Design Ka-band high power amplifiers for Prism, from line-up and architecture through schematic, layout, and hardware bring-up

  • Develop power combining approaches that scale output power while protecting efficiency, linearity, and reliability

  • Build electromagnetic and circuit simulation models (amplifier stages, matching networks, combiners, transitions) to design and evaluate performance before hardware

  • Design supporting circuitry, including bias and sequencing, power conditioning, protection, monitoring, and digital control interfaces

  • Own thermal and packaging considerations for high-dissipation RF hardware in partnership with mechanical and thermal engineers

  • Characterize amplifier performance (output power, compression, PAE, linearity, spurious, stability) and troubleshoot integrated transmit chain performance

  • Drive designs through reliability testing and into production, including test definition and manufacturing support

  • Support integration and field troubleshooting of deployed Prism units

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related engineering discipline

  • 5+ years of RF hardware design experience

  • Hands-on experience designing and building power amplifiers at microwave or millimeter-wave frequencies (Ku-band or higher)

  • Experience taking RF hardware from design through bring-up, characterization, and debug in the lab

  • Proficiency with RF and EM simulation tools (such as Keysight ADS, Cadence AWR, Ansys HFSS, or CST)

  • Comfort with RF test equipment, including network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and power meters

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in electrical engineering with a focus on RF or microwave design

  • Ka-band solid state power amplifier (SSPA) or block upconverter (BUC) design for satellite communications

  • GaN MMIC-based amplifier design, including device selection, matching, stability analysis, and bias networks

  • Power combiner design, including waveguide, spatial, or planar approaches

  • Waveguide component and transition design, including waveguide-to-microstrip transitions, rotary joints, and feeds

  • Thermal management and packaging for high power RF electronics

  • Linearity and modulated signal performance (IMD, ACPR, EVM, spectral regrowth), including linearization techniques

  • Satcom transmit compliance, including emission masks and regulatory limits

  • Design for manufacturing, production test development, and reliability qualification

Compensation:

RF Hardware/Level 3: $140,000-$175,000

RF Hardware/Level 4: $152,000-$190,000

RF Hardware/Level 5: $180,000-$226,000

jobs.title: Lead Avionics Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role

Northwood Space is looking for a Lead Avionics Manufacturing Engineer to lead the manufacturing engineering team responsible for our avionics production processes. This role will own the manufacturing engineering strategy and execution from SMT assembly through board-level acceptance testing, environmental screening, and final box build.

You will be responsible for developing the manufacturing standards, processes, equipment, and controls required to build reliable avionics hardware at increasing production volumes. You will work closely with Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Production to transition designs into repeatable manufacturing processes and continuously improve those processes as our products and production systems mature.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the manufacturing engineering team responsible for avionics production, including SMT, post-SMT processing, board acceptance testing, thermal cycling, and electromechanical box build.

  • Develop and maintain Northwood’s avionics manufacturing standards, processes, design guidelines, and best practices.

  • Own the development, qualification, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes across the avionics production flow.

  • Establish process controls, acceptance criteria, workmanship standards, and manufacturing documentation required to consistently produce high-quality hardware.

  • Lead the selection, implementation, qualification, and improvement of avionics manufacturing equipment and tooling.

  • Partner with design engineering to improve manufacturability, testability, reliability, and production scalability of new avionics designs.

  • Drive new product introduction from engineering prototypes into controlled production processes.

  • Identify production risks and recurring manufacturing issues and drive them to root cause and corrective action.

  • Define and track key manufacturing metrics such as yield, defect rates, rework, cycle time, and process capability.

  • Develop process validation and qualification strategies for new equipment, materials, and manufacturing methods.

  • Work with Quality Engineering to establish inspection, process control, traceability, and nonconformance practices appropriate for aerospace hardware.

  • Mentor and develop manufacturing engineers and technicians while establishing strong engineering ownership on the production floor.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 5+ years of experience in electronics or avionics manufacturing engineering.

  • Basic understanding of SMT manufacturing processes, including stencil printing, pick-and-place, reflow, inspection, and process troubleshooting.

  • Experience developing and improving manufacturing processes for PCBAs and electronic assemblies.

  • Experience supporting products through multiple stages of manufacturing, from PCBA fabrication through integration into higher-level assemblies.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex manufacturing problems from initial investigation through implementation of corrective actions.

  • Experience creating manufacturing documentation, process specifications, work instructions, and production controls.

  • Ability to work directly with engineering and production teams in a fast-paced hardware development and manufacturing environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading manufacturing engineers or owning a significant electronics manufacturing area.

  • Experience with aerospace, defense, automotive, medical device, or other high-reliability electronics manufacturing.

  • Strong knowledge of IPC workmanship and electronics manufacturing standards.

  • Experience with automated optical inspection, X-ray inspection, rework, cleaning, conformal coating, or other PCBA manufacturing processes.

  • Experience developing board-level acceptance test processes and production test equipment.

  • Experience with environmental screening processes such as thermal cycling.

  • Experience with electromechanical assembly and avionics box build.

  • Experience implementing manufacturing processes within an MES and developing production traceability systems.

jobs.title: Power Electronics Engineer (Prism)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.

Role:

As an Electrical Engineer (Power Electronics), you will own the power conversion and distribution electronics for Prism, Northwood's 2.4 meter parabolic antenna for high-throughput satellite links. You will design the power systems that feed Prism's high power RF hardware and support electronics, taking them from architecture through prototype, testing, and production. This is a hands-on role for someone who has designed, built, and debugged power electronics that have to run reliably in the field.

Responsibilities:

  • Design power electronics for Prism, including AC-DC and DC-DC conversion, power distribution, and the supplies that drive high power RF amplifiers

  • Define Prism's power architecture and drive system trades across efficiency, thermal load, reliability, cost, and deployment speed

  • Design load switching, sequencing, and power path protection schemes, including fault detection and recovery

  • Perform schematic capture, PCB layout oversight, and bring-up of power hardware

  • Build circuit and system models to analyze and verify power system performance, including stability, transient response, and efficiency

  • Define interfaces between the power system and Prism's RF, digital, and motion control loads

  • Qualify designs through environmental and EMI/EMC testing

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related engineering discipline

  • 3-5+ years of power electronics hardware design experience

  • Hands-on experience designing switched-mode power converters (buck, boost, flyback, LLC, or similar) at hundreds of watts or more

  • Experience taking power hardware from schematic and layout through bring-up, characterization, and debug in the lab

  • Proficiency with circuit simulation tools such as LTspice, PLECS, or SIMetrix

  • Comfort with power electronics test equipment, including oscilloscopes with differential and current probes, electronic loads, and power analyzers

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in electrical engineering with a focus on power electronics

  • Kilowatt-class AC-DC and isolated DC-DC converter design, including power factor correction

  • Drain supply and bias design for GaN RF power amplifiers, including sequencing and low-ripple regulation

  • Protection circuitry design, including hot-swap, inrush limiting, overcurrent, and reverse-polarity protection

  • Input filter design and control loop compensation for converter stability

  • Surge, lightning, and transient protection for grid-connected outdoor equipment

  • Magnetics design and wide-bandgap (GaN, SiC) power stage design

  • Motor drive power electronics for antenna positioners or motion control systems

  • Thermal design and EMI/EMC mitigation for high-density power hardware

  • Design for manufacturing, production test development, and reliability qualification

Compensation:

Electrical Engineer/Level 2: $104,000-$130,000 per year

Electrical Engineer/Level 3: $122,400-$153,000 per year
